notes.title: Skirmish AMA
notes.content:
We want to talk to you!
Have you played the demo? We're excited to hear what you think of it. Do you have suggestions or questions? We're all ears.
Your feedback and ideas could influence the further development of the game!

Come talk to us on Discord!
We'd like to welcome you on our Discord server during this event. Check the above times, we'll be ready for you!

notes.title: Skirmish Live: Developer battle!
notes.content:
It's time to settle it!

Do thousands of hours of bug fixing make you better?
Do artists secretly practice at home?
Is the outcome of a match completely random?

Join us to find out!
